'''Corsairian Crescent''' was an area of the [[Karthakk system]] under control of the [[Canyon Corsairs]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was rumored that the Corsairs would clamor into their own [[Starfighter combat/Legends|dogfights]] with the locals, hoping to collect loot as the spoils of war. Otherwise nondescript, the Corsairian Crescent proved to be a territory in which only the brave traveled. The region was home a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] patrolled by a number of Corsair [[Man O'war]]s.<ref name="JTL">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Corsairian Crescent was a location in [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']], the [[2004]] expansion pack for the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], prior to the [[Star Wars video games|game's]] closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="JTL" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
